# T tests for MAX

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# t-test takes differences (e.g. group 2 - 1) FOR MAX
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
all_olt_new <- all_olt %>% 
  select(-time_for_answer_correct)



all_olt_wide <- all_olt_new %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = percent_correct) 

all_olt_wide %>% 
  group_by(participant) %>% 
  reframe(extra_diff = `2`-`1`,
          x = factor(0)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = extra_diff, x = x)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red") +
  geom_point(aes(color = participant), size = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    y = "Response difference group 2-1"
  )
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](Memory_Quarto_files/figure-html/t-max-1.png){width=672}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
all_olt_wide<-all_olt_wide %>% 
  group_by(participant) %>% 
  mutate(Difference=`2`-`1`)
all_olt_wide$Condition_Binary<-ifelse(all_olt_wide$condition=="None", 0, 1)
all_olt_wide$Condition_Binary<-factor(all_olt_wide$Condition_Binary, levels=c(0,1), labels=c("None", "Coffein"))


t.test(all_olt_wide$`1`, all_olt_wide$`2`, paired=TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

	Paired t-test

data:  all_olt_wide$`1` and all_olt_wide$`2`
t = 0.88345, df = 8, p-value = 0.4028
alternative hypothesis: true mean difference is not equal to 0
95 percent confidence interval:
 -0.04771021  0.10696947
sample estimates:
mean difference 
     0.02962963 
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
#no statistically significant difference -> also not in boxplots
#p-value = 0.4028


t.test(Difference~Condition_Binary, all_olt_wide)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

	Welch Two Sample t-test

data:  Difference by Condition_Binary
t = 0.55868, df = 6.0832, p-value = 0.5963
alternative hypothesis: true difference in means between group None and group Coffein is not equal to 0
95 percent confidence interval:
 -0.1233952  0.1967285
sample estimates:
   mean in group None mean in group Coffein 
          -0.01333333           -0.05000000 
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
#p-value = 0.5963

ggplot(all_olt_wide, aes(x=Condition_Binary, y=Difference))+
  geom_boxplot(aes(group=Condition_Binary, fill=Condition_Binary),alpha=.3)+
  geom_point(aes(color=Condition_Binary), cex=3, position = position_jitter(height=0, width=0.2))+
  xlab(" ")+
  theme_light()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](Memory_Quarto_files/figure-html/t-max-2.png){width=672}
:::
:::


# Mixed Effects model (MAX)

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(lmerTest)

model_max <- lmer(percent_correct ~ timepoint * condition + (1 | participant),
              data = all_olt)

library(knitr)
knitr::kable(coefficients(summary(model_max)))
```

::: {.cell-output-display}


|                         |   Estimate| Std. Error| df|    t value| Pr(>|t|)|
|:------------------------|----------:|----------:|--:|----------:|------------------:|
|(Intercept)              |  0.6833333|  0.0330344| 14| 20.6855241|          0.0000000|
|timepoint2               | -0.0500000|  0.0467177| 14| -1.0702591|          0.3026081|
|conditionNone            | -0.0300000|  0.0443203| 14| -0.6768913|          0.5095054|
|timepoint2:conditionNone |  0.0366667|  0.0626783| 14|  0.5849976|          0.5678588|


:::
:::
